info.title: Mistvale Admin API
info.description: The Admin API the Mistvale Admin Suite consumes, plus the public content bundle it previews. Generated from the Zod contracts in @mistvale/shared — edit those, then run `pnpm openapi`.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Admin Suite endpoints. Require the admin rank.

bearerAuth.description: Session token, for clients that cannot use cookies.

304.description: Content has not changed since the ETag you sent.

get.description: Served from memory and cached by revision. Send `If-None-Match` with the ETag from a previous response to get a 304 when content has not moved.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag from a previous bundle response.
